failure_actions.label: Keep the card in place
failure_actions.description: Findings or a failed check keep the card in its current lane. A timeout lets the move proceed.

failure_actions.label: Keep the card in place
failure_actions.description: Findings or a failed check keep the card in its current lane. A timeout lets the move proceed.

checks.label: Ask the task assistant
checks.description: Holds the card while the task assistant checks it against the instructions below. Findings or a failed check keep the card in place; a timeout lets the move proceed.

checks.label: The If conditions decide
checks.description: When this Rule's If conditions match the card, Campus keeps it in place at once with the message below. No model request is made and nothing is held; a card the conditions do not match moves as usual.

instruction.label: Check instructions
instruction.help: Describe what must be true of the card before this move may happen.

message.label: Message
message.help: Optional. Shown on the card when the If conditions keep it in place.

check.description: When a person or an agent requests this move, Campus first confirms the move is allowed, then holds the card in place while the task assistant checks it against these instructions. A pass applies the move; findings or failure keep the card where it is. A timeout lets the move proceed with a note on the card; late answers are ignored. Moves Campus makes on its own are not held (see exemptions). The check reads text the requester can edit, so it is a review aid, not a security boundary.

exemptions.label: Staffing by the auto-assigner
exemptions.description: Campus starting a Ready card for the agent it chose, and parking a Department card in Blocked when nobody can staff it.

exemptions.label: Parking a card when its pull request is attached
exemptions.description: Attaching a pull request moves the card from In progress to Blocked to await review. The pull request's Review Rules are its check.

exemptions.label: A person answering a Blocked card
exemptions.description: A person's comment on a Blocked card returns it to Ready.

exemptions.label: The hand-back inside a reassignment
exemptions.description: Reassigning a card returns it to Ready and starts it for the new agent in one step.

exemptions.label: Archiving or deleting a project
exemptions.description: Archiving or deleting a project closes its open cards.

exemptions.label: A release or an expired claim
exemptions.description: A release, an expired lease, or a refused run hands an In progress card back to Ready without a transition request, which is why Campus offers no In progress → Ready edge.

exemptions.label: An Escalation Rule's action
exemptions.description: An enabled Escalation Rule moving a card to Blocked for a person, or returning a Blocked card to Ready.

kinds.enable_disclosure: Enabling this Rule holds each matching board move while the task assistant checks it against this Rule's instructions. Each check is one task-assistant chat turn on this Island's assistant provider, sent the task's title, description, recent comments and chat, and the Rule instructions. Findings or failure keep the card in place. After 10 minutes, a timeout lets the move proceed with a note on the card; late answers are ignored. A Rule whose check is its If conditions keeps a matching card in place at once, in the same request, and makes no model request.

defaults.label: Review on create

task_creation.description: Applies when a person or an agent creates a task. Defaults fill only fields the author left unset; validations refuse the create with a message and never discard or rewrite what the author wrote.

kinds.enable_disclosure: Enabling this Rule applies its defaults and validations to every task a person or an agent creates in its projects. It makes no model requests.

kinds.label: Assignment & routing
kinds.description: Narrow who Campus may hand a task to.

triggers.label: When Campus chooses who picks a task up

destination_kinds.label: Office
destination_kinds.description: One Office on this Island. Archived Offices, mascots and visitors cannot be destinations.

destination_kinds.label: Department
destination_kinds.description: Every Office on this Island whose specialty names this department.

conditions.label: Priority
conditions.description: Route only tasks with one of these priorities. Leave it empty to route every priority.

precedence.label: The Rule narrows; Campus still chooses
precedence.description: Campus's own eligibility (capability, provider, credential, rate limits, recent failed starts and staffing) stays authoritative. The Rule keeps only its destinations among the eligible Offices. One left is assigned directly; several go to the reviewer to choose among; none leaves the Rule skipped, recorded in run history, and Campus chooses from every eligible Office. An Office pulling work itself is offered only tasks whose routing Rules include it.

assignment.description: Applies when Campus chooses who picks a task up: a Ready card started with “Assign to the next best available agent”, a Department card being staffed, and an Office asking for its next task. The Rule narrows the eligible Offices to its destinations; it never assigns an Office Campus would not.

kinds.enable_disclosure: Enabling this Rule narrows who Campus may hand its tasks to: when Campus chooses who picks a task up, and when an Office asks for its next task, only this Rule's destinations that Campus's own eligibility allows are offered. One eligible destination is assigned directly; several go to the reviewer to choose among; none lets Campus choose from every eligible Office. It makes no model requests of its own.

kinds.label: Escalation
kinds.description: Respond to stuck, risky or late work with one Campus action.

triggers.label: When Campus sweeps for stuck work

conditions.label: Blocked for too long
conditions.description: A card that has sat in Blocked longer than the threshold.

conditions.label: Waiting on review for too long
conditions.description: An Imaginarium idea still waiting on Campus's auto-review after the threshold.

conditions.label: Runs keep failing to start
conditions.description: A card whose runs refused to start at least the threshold number of times in the last 7 days and that is not being worked on.

conditions.label: A claim expired
conditions.description: The lease sweep reclaimed a card whose holder went silent, and nobody has picked it up since.

conditions.label: Department work nobody can staff
conditions.description: A Department card with no holder past the threshold, or one Campus parked in Blocked because it could not staff the specialty.

actions.label: Comment on the card
actions.description: Posts a status comment from Workspace Rules with the Rule's note. It does not count as a person answering a Blocked card.

actions.label: Move to Blocked for a person
actions.description: Moves the card to Blocked as needs_input with a Rails-written reason; the Rule's note becomes the recommended direction. A card already in Blocked is left where it is. Offered only for conditions whose cards Campus may move itself: moving a Ready card to Blocked is a person's review decision, so those conditions comment instead.

actions.label: Return to Ready
actions.description: Moves a Blocked card back to Ready so it can be picked up again.

sweep.description: Campus checks every enabled Escalation Rule once a minute, opens one escalation per condition occurrence, applies the action once, and resolves it when the condition clears. A new escalation opens only if the condition recurs.

note.label: Note
note.help: Optional. Added to the comment, or offered as the recommended direction on a Blocked card.

escalation.description: Responds to stuck, risky or late work with one Campus action, once per occurrence.

kinds.enable_disclosure: Enabling this Rule has Campus check its condition once a minute and apply its action once per occurrence: a comment from Workspace Rules, a move to Blocked for a person, or a return to Ready. It makes no model requests.

labels.combine: Chosen values within one condition are alternatives; every condition must hold.

disclosure.text: Enabling this Rule starts paid vendor model requests owned by this Island. Campus sends the Rule instructions, exact pull request identifiers, and only the verified bounded pull request diff to the configured Anthropic, OpenAI, or xAI model provider. In a review team, the aggregator also receives the child review results. The sandbox cannot read the repository checkout or operator files. The provider processes and may retain this content under the operator's provider account terms. A single review starts one logical reviewer; a team starts one per reviewer plus one aggregator. Each reviewer can make multiple metered provider requests. All Rules share the Island's active-reviewer and 12-request hourly limits. A non-visitor Agent may initiate at most six admissions per rolling hour, reserve or settle at most $6 of provider cost per rolling hour, and keep one exact-target review active at a time; all team children count against that initiating Agent. Work refused by a limit is recorded as failed and requires a new exact-head review after capacity clears. Campus runs every call in a bounded, read-only review environment. Codex subscription reviews reserve the full supported model output maximum because the subscription service does not accept a smaller output cap. This can exhaust review capacity even when the eventual answer is short. Current limits prevent Agent-initiated Codex subscription reviews even after shared capacity clears. Human-initiated reviews remain subject to Island limits.
